mapper.select: select w.id, w.work_order_no, w.fault_record_id, w.equipment_id, e.code as equipment_code, e.name as equipment_name, a.name as area_name, w.priority, w.status, w.maintainer_id, m.display_name as maintainer_name, w.due_at, w.created_at, f.fault_type, f.description as fault_description, w.assigned_at, w.accepted_at, w.solution, w.result_description, w.submitted_at, w.verifier_id, v.display_name as verifier_name, w.verification_passed, w.verification_remark, w.verified_at, w.completed_at, w.cancelled_at, w.cancel_reason, w.updated_at from work_order w join fault_record f on f.id = w.fault_record_id join equipment e on e.id = w.equipment_id join area a on a.id = e.area_id left join sys_user m on m.id = w.maintainer_id left join sys_user v on v.id = w.verifier_id where w.id = #{workOrderId}
select maintainer_id from work_order where id = #{workOrderId}

select f.url from work_order w join biz_attachment b on b.biz_type = 'FAULT' and b.biz_id = w.fault_record_id join file_object f on f.id = b.file_id where w.id = #{workOrderId} order by b.sort_no, b.id

select id, work_order_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, remark, operated_at from work_order_operation where work_order_id = #{workOrderId} order by operated_at asc, id asc
select exists(select 1 from work_order where id = #{workOrderId})
mapper.insert: insert into work_order (work_order_no, fault_record_id, equipment_id, priority, status) values (#{workOrderNo}, #{faultRecordId}, #{equipmentId}, #{priority}, #{status})

insert into work_order_operation (work_order_id, operation_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, remark, operated_at) values (#{workOrderId}, #{operationType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{remark}, #{operatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, work_order_no, fault_record_id, equipment_id, priority, status, maintainer_id, due_at, assigned_at , accepted_at , solution , result_description , submitted_at , verifier_id , verification_passed , verification_remark , verified_at , completed_at , cancelled_at , cancel_reason , version from work_order where id = #{workOrderId}
mapper.update: update work_order set status = #{toStatus}, verifier_id = #{verifierId}, verification_passed = #{passed}, verification_remark = #{remark}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt}, completed_at = case when #{passed} = true then #{verifiedAt} else null end, version = version + 1 where id = #{workOrderId} and status = 'PENDING_VERIFICATION' and version = #{version}

update work_order set status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancel_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 where id = #{workOrderId} and status in ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT', 'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') and version = #{version}
